caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic cup positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The cup is cylindrical with slightly outwardly flaring rim and a band of simple repeating decorative elements around its base. The surface of the cup features ornate, leaf-like patterns around the bottom third, and two sets of engraved letters and symbols appear on the upper part; the upper group reads "AM WAM" with a cross-like design above, and the lower group reads "IH EHI" also flanked by a cross symbol. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil, emphasizing the reflective, metallic nature of the cup, and creating a realistic depiction through the use of careful shading and fine lines. There are no other objects or elements present, and the only text besides the engravings on the cup is the artist's name, "DOROTHY DWYIN," inscribed in small letters at the lower left of the page.
title: Silver Beaker
